source:
A man Hisora meets in town, with a somewhat inhuman expression. While friendly towards everyone, he's said to be abnormal and dangerous, as he can do cruel things calmly and with an innocent smile. He's quite friendly with Hisora, to the point of a strong obsession.

[Source [URL=https://zombilica.com/games/nienomati_iromusubi/chara_0635.html] official website profile.[/URL]]
